name: Biomedical and Health Sciences Dual Credit (Richmond SD38 with KPU)
org: Richmond School District 38 and Kwantlen Polytechnic University
what_you_do: Take four college level health science courses full time at KPU Surrey from February to June of Grade 12. You earn high school and university credit.
who_can_apply: Richmond SD38 students. Must be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Grade 11 students apply to start in semester 2 of Grade 12. Needs Biology 11 and Chemistry 11 at B, and Language Arts 12 at C+.
deadline_text: The 2027-28 application form is posted and says to apply now. Due March 9, 2027.
how_to_apply: Get the form on the district page or at the school Career Programs board. Send it to the Career Programs office in person or by email. You need 2 teacher references, a reference letter and a resume.
notes: Earns 16 high school credits and 12 KPU credits. As of Nov 4, 2026 the 2027-28 form is posted.
